title: Score evidence timestamps from attached transcript artifacts
description:
As a scoring platform operator, I want timestamp enrichment to use transcript artifacts attached to an Item, so that asynchronous scoring preserves evidence positions without embedding large transcript payloads in metadata.

Feature: Evidence timestamp enrichment from Item attachments

Scenario: Deepgram is available only as an Item attachment
Given a score explanation contains quoted evidence
And the score metadata does not embed a Deepgram payload
And the Item has an attached Deepgram JSON file
When timestamp enrichment runs
Then the explanation is enriched with timestamp brackets
And the resulting score result exposes start and end time seconds.

Out of scope:
- Changing score prompt behavior.
- Re-embedding raw Deepgram payloads in Item metadata.
